scripts.lint:eradication: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function walk(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):path.join(d,e.name))}const hits=walk('src').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.ts')).flatMap(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n').map((l,i)=>({f,i:i+1,l})).filter(({l})=>/ProcessManager|ResultStore|ResultCleanupJob/.test(l)));if(hits.length){hits.forEach(({f,i,l})=>console.error(f+':'+i+' '+l.trim()));process.exit(1)}else console.log('OK: no legacy references')"
scripts.lint:spawn-guard: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src=fs.readFileSync('src/services/BackgroundWorker.ts','utf8');const hits=src.split('\n').map((l,i)=>({i:i+1,l})).filter(({l})=>/child_process\.exec/.test(l));if(hits.length){hits.forEach(({i,l})=>console.error('BackgroundWorker.ts:'+i+': '+l.trim()));process.exit(1)}else console.log('OK: no exec() usage')"
